name: Doombot Firmware Link
author: Antigravity CTF Team
description: We recovered a logic chip from a downed Doombot v4 patrol droid. We extracted its activation verification binary 'doombot_auth'. The binary validates authentication nonces using a proprietary cryptographic transformation. Analyze the binary in Ghidra/IDA, understand the transformation algorithm, bypass its anti-analysis checks, and interact with the live Doombot C2 node to extract the dynamic deployment directive.
